value.zh: 布甸而家做特價，每買 3 個就送多 1 個。每個布甸要 17 元 90 仙。媽媽一共拎走 4 個布甸，其中 1 個免費，一共要畀幾多錢？
value.en: Puddings are on sale: buy 3 and get 1 free. Each pudding costs 17 dollars and 90 cents. Mum takes home 4 puddings in total, including 1 free pudding. How much should she pay?

patches.reason: 釐清4個為連贈品在內的總數，並非付費買4個。

value.zh: 餅店職員將 74 個月餅平均裝入 6 個禮盒裏面。每個禮盒有幾多個月餅？仲淨低幾多個月餅？
value.en: A bakery worker packs 74 mooncakes equally into six gift boxes. How many mooncakes are there in each gift box? How many mooncakes are left?

patches.reason: 修正「月份」筆誤。

value.zh: 每盒雞蛋要 $28。媽媽買咗半打（6 盒）雞蛋，一共要畀幾多錢？
value.en: Each carton of eggs costs $28. Mum bought half dozen cartons of eggs. How much should she pay?

patches.reason: 釐清半打是6盒，和單價及英文一致。

value.zh: 半打即係 6 盒雞蛋，算式係 28 × 6。
value.en: Half a dozen cartons means 6 cartons: 28 × 6.

patches.reason: 明確數量單位為盒。

value.zh: 睇牙醫嘅時間小秘密
value.en: When does the dentist visit end?

patches.reason: 計算結果未過中午，刪去標題的過午暗示。

value.zh: 52 分未滿 60 分，唔使進位；小時仍然係上午 11 時，結果係上午 11 時 52 分 36 秒。
value.en: 52 minutes is less than 60, so there is no carry to the hour. The result is 11:52:36 a.m.; it has not passed noon.

patches.reason: 更正未過中午的時段判斷。

value.zh: 睇完嗰陣係上午 11 時 52 分 36 秒。
value.en: He finished at 11:52:36 a.m.

patches.reason: 同步修正答案鐘面。

value.zh: 分鐘加完係 34 分，唔使再加一次 10 分；小時仍然係上午 9 時，合埋係幾點幾分幾秒？
value.en: The minute result is 34; do not add the starting 10 minutes again. Keep the hour at 9 a.m. and combine the hour, minutes and seconds.

patches.reason: 避免重複加起始分鐘。

value.zh: 到達嗰陣係上午 9 時 34 分 30 秒。
value.en: He arrived at 9:34:30 a.m.

patches.reason: 同步修正答案鐘面。

value.zh: 56 分未滿 60 分，唔使向小時進位；時間仍然係上午 11 時，合埋係幾點幾分幾秒？
value.en: 56 minutes is less than 60, so there is no carry to the hour. It is still 11 a.m. Combine the hour, minutes and seconds.

patches.reason: 更正未過中午的時段判斷。

value.zh: 熄火嗰陣係上午 11 時 56 分 10 秒。
value.en: She turned off the stove at 11:56:10 a.m.

patches.reason: 同步修正答案鐘面。

value.zh: 分針已過 3 字、未到下一小格，表示已過 15 分；秒數再睇秒針。
value.en: The minute hand has passed 3 but has not reached the next small tick, so 15 whole minutes have passed. Read the seconds from the second hand.

patches.reason: 和分針隨秒數微調的精準鐘面一致。

value.zh: 一個三針時鐘顯示：時針喺 2 同 3 之間，分針已過 4 字、未到下一小格，秒針指住 6 字，時間係喺上午。當時係幾點幾分幾秒？
value.en: A three-hand clock shows the hour hand between 2 and 3; the minute hand has passed 4 but not the next small tick; and the second hand points to 6. It is in the morning. What time is it?

patches.reason: 分針包含秒數微調，改用已過整分鐘的描述。

value.zh: 分針已過 4 字、未到下一小格：4 × 5 = 20 分。
value.en: The minute hand has passed 4 but not the next tick: 4 × 5 = 20 whole minutes.

patches.reason: 同步修正鐘面讀數提示。

value.zh: 一個三針時鐘顯示：時針喺 6 同 7 之間，分針已過 7 字後第 2 小格、未到第 3 小格，秒針指住 10 字後第 3 小格，時間係喺下午。當時係幾點幾分幾秒？
value.en: A three-hand clock shows the hour hand between 6 and 7; the minute hand has passed the second small tick after 7 but has not reached the third; and the second hand points to the third small tick after 10. It is in the afternoon. What time is it?

patches.reason: 分針包含秒數微調，改用已過整分鐘的描述。

value.zh: 分針已過 7 字後第 2 小格、未到第 3 小格：7 × 5 + 2 = 37 分。
value.en: The minute hand has passed the second small tick after 7, but not the third: 7 × 5 + 2 = 37 whole minutes.

patches.reason: 同步修正鐘面讀數提示。

value.zh: 另一場「校際問答比賽」喺下午 6 時 28 分 46 秒結束，成個活動一共進行咗 2 小時 13 分鐘 40 秒。咁成個活動係幾點幾分幾秒開始嘅呢？
value.en: Another Interschool Quiz ended at six twenty-eight and forty-six seconds in the afternoon. The whole event ran for 2 hours, 13 minutes and 40 seconds. What time did the whole event start?

patches.reason: 明確為獨立比賽，避免和第17題開始時間互相矛盾。

value.zh: 記錄以下長度為單一單位：(a) 90000 m = 幾多 km？ (b) 一條跑步路線全長 42 公里，即係幾多 metres（m）？
value.en: Record each measurement in a single unit: (a) 90000 m = how many km? (b) A running route is 42 kilometres long, which is how many metres?

patches.reason: 保留42公里換算數值，不以正式馬拉松賽程作事實描述。

value.zh: (b) 42 公里乘 1000 換做米，等於幾多 metres？
value.en: (b) Multiply the 42-kilometre route by 1000 to convert it to metres.

patches.reason: 和修正後情境一致。

value.zh: 喺 km / m / cm / mm 入面揀啱單位：(a) 一道門嘅高度通常大約係 210 ____； (b) 一個學校禮堂大約闊 30 ____。
value.en: Choose the suitable unit from km / m / cm / mm: (a) The height of a door is usually around 210 ____; (b) A school hall is about 30 ____ wide.

patches.reason: 30米的闊度改用合理的禮堂情境。

value.zh: (a) 門高 210 cm 即係 2.1 米，所以填 cm。
value.en: (a) A 210 cm door is 2.1 metres high. Choose cm.

patches.reason: 更正2米等於210cm的錯誤等式。

value.zh: (b) 學校禮堂闊 30 米屬合理的長度，所以填 m。
value.en: (b) A school hall can be 30 metres wide. Choose m.

patches.reason: 和禮堂情境一致。

value.zh: 三針時鐘顯示「校際問答比賽」嘅開始時間。比賽喺下午開始，當時係幾點幾分幾秒？
value.en: The three-hand clock shows the start time of the Interschool Quiz. The quiz started in the afternoon. What time was it?

patches.reason: 刪去「右邊」位置描述，配合電腦及手機的不同排版。
